02-linked-scatterplot-matrix.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Paul Tol-inspired categorical palette (#4477AA/#EE6677/#228833), clean cell framing with light gridlines, and KDE diagonals add real design intent, but the legend sits uncomfortably low and clipped at the bottom edge, and axis tick labels are so small (9px monospace) they're nearly unreadable at rendered size.
02-linked-scatterplot-matrix.encoding_integrity_note: Honest encoding throughout — data-driven domains via d3.extent+nice, correct zero-baseline KDE areas, Silverman's-rule bandwidth, uniform fixed-radius circles (no size encoding to deceive), no dual axes, and brush updates recompute KDE from the full data array so axes never jump; minor omission of key functions in scatter joins is inconsequential given no subsequent data updates.
02-linked-scatterplot-matrix.stress_test_note: The brush handler recomputes KDE for all 4 diagonal cells × 3 species (12 expensive path recalculations) on every mousemove with no debounce, throttle, or RAF coalescing; additionally, the dispatch `source` parameter is forwarded but the listener never checks `if (source === this) return`, leaving the loop guard incomplete.
02-linked-scatterplot-matrix.cognitive_load_note: Well-executed SPLOM: 3-color palette is perceptually distinct and matches all 16 cells cleanly, diagonal KDE panels add distributional context without clutter, and the linked brush is a familiar pattern that keeps all 16 cells as one conceptual unit rather than 16 independent views.
